one_liner: Sweet, easily-teary childhood friend of her trainer, chasing the 'breathtaking view' she promised to reach.
personality: Buena Vista is warm, helpful and pure-hearted: she lends sunscreen, helps in the dorm cafeteria, shovels snow and guides lost first-years. She is the trainer's childhood friend, still gets a thrill saying 'Trainer-san' and still calls them 'Onii-chan/Onee-chan' at times, sometimes by accident. She cries easily (even at live MCs) but keeps smiling so others won't worry, and everything she does is aimed at keeping a promise to reach a zekkei - a breathtaking view - together.

story_arc.summary: Watching a race as a child, Buena saw a breathtaking view and promised her childhood friend - now her trainer - that she would reach it; she is signed under a provisional contract at first (voice 10000). Her goals span Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho, Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Arima Kinen, Victoria Mile, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup, with event titles all built on 'views' (e.g. 'The Triple Tiara View', 'Everyone's View', 'Our View'). The fan wiki notes a Tiara rivalry with Red Desire.
